args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 18%, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** checkout-api status and deployment history:
   - Current production version was **v2.3.1** — unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
   - Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and unhealthy; the most recent **healthy** production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api, documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that root cause investigation is ongoing. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified** post-rollback status: checkout-api is now on v2.3.0, **healthy** in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback to v2.3.0 was a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
